verdict.rationale: Undermind's core product is an agentic research assistant: you hand it an open-ended research goal and it plans its own searches, follows citations and authors, and returns ranked papers with a written synthesis. Users who ran it describe it as an AI research assistant that took minutes to surface papers they had missed. Missing for 10: delegation is evidenced only for literature research, not general tasks; the in-app assistant interface is undocumented (most capability docs describe MCP tools exposed to external agents); and there is no first-party documentation of delegating note-writing or PDF Q&A from within the product's own UI.
